design: Two identical-prompt independent calls for each material/model. Same reference per material. Original Recraft outputs 2048 square, FLUX outputs 1024 square; comparison PNGs normalize to 1024 without grading. No images approved or installed.

generations.prompt: Create a NEW square terrain illustration of a dense crimson-clover canopy viewed vertically from above. Match the reference's fine scale and matte gouache/colored-pencil botanical treatment: hundreds of small overlapping three-leaf clusters, rounded oval leaflets with pale chevrons, sparse tiny crimson buds, muted forest and olive greens. Roughly thirty small leaf clusters should fit across the image width. Keep scale, density and diffuse lighting uniform across the whole square. Invent a completely new irregular arrangement rather than copying the reference. Living foliage fills every edge. Clover only: no grass, other species, oversized foreground leaves, border, white paper, vignette, grid, text or perspective.
generations.reason: Preserves almost the entire original leaf/bud layout; slightly warmer/lighter treatment is not independent composition.
generations.inspection: Each first attempt inspected individually; all eight reviewed on material comparison sheets at common display size. Correlation is supporting evidence, not the verdict by itself.

generations.prompt: Create a NEW square terrain illustration, viewed vertically from above: a continuous dense carpet of very short meadow grass with a few tiny three-leaf clovers scattered throughout. Use the reference ONLY for fine detail scale, muted green palette and matte gouache/pencil brushwork. Thousands of tiny short grass marks point in varied directions. Clover occupies about five percent of the surface; none is a focal plant. Keep foliage size and density uniform. Invent a completely new arrangement, do not trace or reproduce the reference's clover positions or grain. Edge-to-edge vegetation under flat diffuse light. No border, empty backing, shadows, horizon, text, grid or long upright blades.
generations.reason: Fresh arrangement, full bleed and fine grass scale. Paler/quieter than reference; second attempt does not hold clover density/composition behavior.
generations.inspection: Each first attempt inspected individually; all eight reviewed on material comparison sheets at common display size. Correlation is supporting evidence, not the verdict by itself.
